headline: Canada Pledges C$560m Tropical-Forest Loan
deck: Canada committed up to C$560 million over four years to the Tropical Forest Forever Facility through a loan from its existing climate-finance envelope.
body: Prime Minister Mark Carney announced an initial Canadian contribution of up to C$560 million over four years to the Tropical Forest Forever Facility after meeting Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in Manila, the Prime Minister’s Office said [E1].

Global Affairs Canada says the contribution will be a loan financed from Canada’s existing international climate-finance envelope and is intended to support the facility’s launch and initial capitalization [E2]. The paper last covered a different Canadian commitment on Aug. 24; this announcement sets out a loan commitment, not delivered finance.

evidence_box.fragment: Today, the Prime Minister, Mark Carney, met with the President of Brazil, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, on the margins of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Summit in Manila, Philippines, where he announced an initial contribution of up to $560 million over four years to the Tropical Forest Forever Facility (TFFF).
